potential_signatory_as_assignee.description: Indicates whether the user may sign as an inspection assignee. Only present when no filters[inspection_id] is provided; clients should apply the assignee check themselves. Always true when potential_signatory is true.

x-changelog.summary: Updated checklist users endpoint with signatory filters and inspection scoping
x-changelog.description:
Added `filters[potential_signatory]` and optional `filters[inspection_id]`
to the checklist users endpoint.

New response fields:
- `potential_signatory`: always returned; true when the user is eligible to sign.
- `potential_signatory_as_creator`: only returned when `filters[inspection_id]` is
  omitted, for client-side creator scoping.
- `potential_signatory_as_assignee`: only returned when `filters[inspection_id]` is
  omitted, for client-side assignee scoping.

Behavior notes:
- When `filters[inspection_id]` is provided, signatory eligibility is evaluated
  in that inspection's scope. Closed inspections return no eligible signatories.
- An unknown `filters[inspection_id]` falls back to project-wide evaluation.
- Existing behavior is preserved when neither filter is provided.
